svg.text: TPU-Distil: On-Policy Agentic Self-Correction (SCoRe-RL) on Cloud TPU v6e
Distilling Multi-Turn Error Recovery from DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus (v6e-16) into Qwen3-30B-A3B / Qwen3-Next (v6e-4 & v6e-8)
4-File Engine (trajectory.py • sandbox.py • splicer.py • score_reward.py) | 2,048 Verified MPS Trajectories | 48-Layer LoRA GRPO
Zero Oracle Test Feedback (include_test_feedback=False) • 100% Observation Loss Masking (loss_mask=0.0) • 256-Token MXU Alignment
1. End-to-End SCoRe-RL Architecture on Cloud TPU v6e
Stage 0: Student Rollout to First Error s_m (TPU v6e-4)
• Qwen3-30B-A3B executes bash/python in rootless ContainerSandbox
• Halts at first failing step m (exit_code != 0); saves git diff snapshot s_m
Stage 1A: Mixed-Policy Splicing (MPS) with Teacher (TPU v6e-16)
• DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus generates recovery suffix (a*_m..a*_T) from s_m
• Strict loss_mask=0.0 on 811,860 obs tokens; 1.0 on 539,906 recovery tokens
• 8 TPU v6e chips (12 layers/chip via jax.lax.scan, 256-aligned sequences)
• Rank-64 LoRA (q/k/v/o_proj, 192 matrices) + Frozen MoE Router (gate_proj)
Stage 2: Short-Horizon Branching LoRA GRPO (TPU v6e-8)
• Branches G=8 on-policy rollouts directly from cached error state s_m (H_rem=4)
• Reference policy pi_ref via LoRA scale=0.0 on same slice (0 GB extra HBM)
• Hybrid reward: R_term + alpha * Phi(s_t, a_t) - beta * D_KL → 32.0% Pass@1
Stage 1: 48-Layer Masked SFT Loss (20 Steps, lr=5e-4, seq_len=256)
Stage 2: Short-Horizon GRPO Surrogate Loss (36 Steps, G=8, lr=8e-5)
MoE Router Entropy Drift: 0.028 nats (BC) / 0.048 nats (SCoRe-SFT) — Zero Router Collapse
4. Per-Task TPU Log-Prob Margin on 8 Recovered Tasks
Margin = Delta_LogProb(k=0 Recovery) - Delta_LogProb(k=1 Baseline); > 0 Selects Verified Fix
5. Cloud TPU v6e-8 Per-Chip HBM Telemetry (48 Layers)
8 Physical TPU v6 lite Chips Across 2 Hosts • 12 Transformer Layers + 96 Active Experts / Chip
Safety Ceiling: 28.0 GB / Chip (Physical Capacity: 31.24 GiB)
Peak VJP Backward HBM (14.51 GB max)
1. Why Pure Behavioral Cloning (BC) Plateaus at 18.0% (+1 Task):
Training only on error-free teacher transcripts leaves the student brittle when
its own Turn-0 command fails (P(pass_1 | fail_0) = 4.65%, recovering only 2/43).
2. First-Error Splicing (MPS) + Obs Masking Reaches 24.0% (+4 Tasks):
Splicing Teacher recoveries at the exact student failure state s_m and setting
loss_mask=0.0 on tool stdout/stderr prevents hallucination and reaches 11.63% W→R.
3. Short-Horizon GRPO Doubles Gain Over SFT to 32.0% (+8 Tasks):
On-policy MBPP sandbox rollouts penalize no-op bash headers (#!/bin/bash, mkdir -p)
and boost self-contained heredoc scripts (python3 << 'EOF'), hitting 20.93% W→R.
4. Zero-Overhead Reference Policy & Frozen MoE Router on TPU v6e-8:
Computing pi_ref logprobs by setting lora_scale=0.0 saves 89 GB of duplicate base
weights, keeping peak HBM at 14.51 GB/chip (<50% of 31.24 GiB v6e capacity).
